# Analysis 4: Revenue Growth and Subscription Value

> All figures are synthetic scenario comparisons. Legacy D30 means a nested checkpoint proxy, not session-based exact-day retention. Recovery indices compare reference windows, not matched individual outcomes or trust.

## Decision

**Mixed: growth with guardrail warning.** Revenue per day rises 72.21% and
paying users per day rise 57.94% around launch.
The new product supplies 25.47% of the arithmetic revenue increase, not a causal
incrementality estimate. Combined adjacent revenue per service payer-day changes
-11.55% at launch and
-13.32% in the following 14 days.

## Measurement and source correction

The baseline is April 15–May 14, launch is May 15–June 14, and post-14 is
June 15–28, 2025. February is a secondary historical reference. The baseline
includes a content gap and recovery, so neither reference is an untreated control.
Compare daily amounts because the windows contain 30, 31 and 14 days.

The audit corrected service PU: it must lie between the maximum and sum of daily
product purchasers. The old independent target violated this in 1,302 date-region
rows. Sales and revenue are unchanged. PU is now a feasible synthetic union,
not reconstructed player identities.

| Metric | Local baseline | Launch |
|---|---:|---:|
| Paying users per day | 1812.37 | 2862.52 |
| DAU-weighted conversion (%) | 2.37 | 3.43 |
| Revenue per service payer-day (USD) | 10.55 | 11.50 |

Revenue per service payer-day uses sum(daily PU), not deduplicated monthly users
or purchasers of a specific offer. It is sensitive to the assumed buyer overlap.

Revenue lift is chiefly a legacy-catalog rebound. Launch revenue is still
40.41% below February.
Taxes, refunds, fees, acquisition cost and contribution margin are unobserved.

## Adjacent offers

![Adjacent offers](../../images/adjacent_product_cannibalization.png)

| product_name | launch_change_pct | post_14_change_pct | launch_warning | post_14_warning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Monthly Mission Pass | -8.85 | -10.05 | True | True |
| 30-Day Premium Currency Pass | -12.78 | -15.89 | True | True |
| Account Growth Booster | -15.33 | -16.54 | True | True |
| Combined adjacent set | -11.55 | -13.32 | True | True |

All three products cross the -5% warning during launch and post-14 under the
published payer assumption. Absolute combined adjacent revenue per day is still
21.71% above baseline in post-14.
This is an allocation warning, not proof of an absolute revenue collapse or
same-buyer switching. Separate new-payer mix, purchase timing and buyer migration.

**The previous JP-only launch warning is withdrawn.** Every region now crosses
the launch guardrail; Global West has the largest decline. Regional priorities
must follow corrected evidence, not an authored regional story.

## Robustness and next decision

[Baseline and payer-overlap sensitivity](../sensitivity.md) checks plausible
aggregate union assumptions. These are assumption scenarios, not confidence
intervals. Cross-product buyer identities are not identified by these inputs.
Do not remove an offer on this evidence. First instrument unique purchasers,
renewals and net spend; then randomize offer messaging with catalog-wide revenue
per eligible assigned user and retention guardrails. See [decision plan](../decision_plan.md).
